result.summary: The image shows a high-capacity urban intersection adjacent to a major transit station entrance. While it features robust pedestrian infrastructure including wide sidewalks, high-visibility crosswalks, and dedicated signals, the multi-lane roadway creates a significant crossing distance.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground crossing the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns near pedestrian waiting areas.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner near the transit station entrance

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban arterial road with at least four travel lanes, creating a significant crossing distance for pedestrians. While sidewalks and some crosswalk markings are present, the environment lacks physical protection like medians or curb extensions to mitigate exposure to high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to multiple lanes of traffic for a prolonged period without a mid-block refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Travel Lanes
hazards.description: The width of the travel lanes and the overall road scale likely encourage higher vehicle speeds, increasing the risk of severe injury in a collision.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes in the center of the image

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reconfigure the roadway to reduce the number of through lanes, which can slow traffic and provide space for a center turn lane or bike lanes.
